name: The Lobby
description: Level 0 is the first level of the Backrooms. It consists of a seemingly infinite network of interconnected rooms, all sharing the same yellow wallpaper, damp carpet, and buzzing fluorescent lights. The layout is non-Euclidean and constantly shifting, making navigation nearly impossible.
atmosphere: yellow wallpaper, buzzing fluorescent lights, damp carpet, mono-yellow hum, musty smell, non-Euclidean layout
exits: Staying too long may cause descent to Level 1
tips: Listen for the hum of lights
lore: Level 0 is where most people first arrive in the Backrooms. The mono-yellow hum of the fluorescent lights is both comforting and maddening.

name: The Exit?
description: Level 0.01 is a sublevel of Level 0. It appears to be a small, confined space that resembles a possible exit from the Backrooms. However, the exit is an illusion - the door leads back to Level 0.
atmosphere: small room, door that leads nowhere, fluorescent lights, false hope
exits: The door leads back to Level 0
tips: Don't be fooled by the door
lore: Level 0.01 is a cruel joke of the Backrooms. It offers the illusion of escape, only to trap you in a loop.

name: Red Rooms
description: The Red Rooms are a dangerous variant of Level 0. Instead of yellow wallpaper, the walls are covered in dark red, almost blood-colored patterns. The fluorescent lights flicker ominously, and the carpet is damp with a liquid that is definitely not water.
atmosphere: red wallpaper, flickering lights, damp carpet, ominous hum, sense of dread
lore: The Red Rooms are what happens when Level 0 becomes corrupted. Some say it is a punishment for those who stay too long.

name: Concrete Jungle
description: Level 11 is a sprawling, desolate cityscape of monolithic buildings and winding asphalt roads. The architectural design varies wildly - from modern skyscrapers to ancient stone buildings. The city appears infinite, extending in all directions without any visible boundary.
atmosphere: endless city, diverse architecture, empty streets, Facelings, urban decay, fog
exits: Walking far enough in one direction
tips: The city is infinite but has patterns
lore: Level 11 is often called The City or Concrete Jungle. It is one of the most habitable levels in the Backrooms, with many wanderers establishing permanent settlements here.

name: Sublimity
description: Level 37, commonly referred to as the Poolrooms, is an expansive complex of interconnected rooms and corridors submerged in undulating, lukewarm water. The water is crystal clear and surprisingly clean. The architecture is surreal - white tiles, arched doorways, and windows that show only sky.
atmosphere: crystal clear water, white tiles, arched doorways, surreal beauty, lukewarm water, echoing sounds
tips: The water is safe to drink
lore: The Poolrooms are one of the most beautiful levels in the Backrooms. The water is always lukewarm and surprisingly clean.

name: The Sunset Hotel
description: Level 188 is a vast, labyrinthine hotel that appears to be perpetually bathed in the warm glow of sunset. The architecture is elegant but dated, with velvet wallpaper, crystal chandeliers, and thick carpets. The hotel has infinite rooms, most of which are empty but well-maintained.
atmosphere: sunset glow, velvet wallpaper, crystal chandeliers, elegant architecture, warm lighting, infinite rooms
exits: Taking the elevator to specific floors
tips: The staff are Facelings but generally helpful
lore: The Sunset Hotel is one of the most comfortable levels in the Backrooms. The sunset never ends, the rooms are always clean, and the Faceling staff are surprisingly helpful.

name: Pipe Dreams
description: Level 2 consists of long, dark maintenance hallways filled with pipes, electrical conduits, and machinery. The heat is oppressive and the air is thick with steam. This level is significantly more dangerous than Level 0 or Level 1.
atmosphere: dark maintenance hallways, pipes, steam, oppressive heat, machinery noise, claustrophobic
lore: Level 2 is where the Backrooms becomes truly dangerous. The pipes whisper and the steam burns.

name: Terror Hotel
description: Level 5 is a vast, labyrinthine hotel with endless corridors, locked rooms, and a perpetual sense of dread. The architecture is inconsistent and reality feels unstable. Unlike the Sunset Hotel, Level 5 is actively hostile.
atmosphere: endless corridors, locked rooms, breathing walls, moving shadows, perpetual dread, unstable reality
resources: Food (in some rooms, but may be poisoned)
lore: Level 5 is the dark mirror of the Sunset Hotel. Where Level 188 offers comfort, Level 5 offers only terror. The hotel is alive, and it feeds on fear.

name: Lights Out
description: Level 6 is almost completely dark. The only illumination comes from rare emergency lights or bioluminescent organisms. This level is extremely dangerous due to the numerous hostile entities that thrive in darkness.
atmosphere: near-total darkness, emergency lights, bioluminescence, echoing footsteps, alive darkness
tips: Never turn off your light source
lore: Level 6 is where light goes to die. The darkness here is not merely the absence of light - it is a living thing, hungry and aware.

name: Darkened Suburbs
description: Level 9 resembles a suburban neighborhood at night. The houses are dark and empty, the streets are deserted, and the only sound is the distant hum of power lines. The level is eerily peaceful but harbors hidden dangers.
atmosphere: suburban night, dark houses, deserted streets, power line hum, eerie peace
exits: Walking to the edge of the neighborhood
lore: Level 9 is a cruel parody of suburban life. The houses look normal from the outside, but inside they are wrong - rooms that don't connect, stairs that lead nowhere, windows that show impossible views.
